We have created lightweight and serverless tools that can be run directly from your browser using
[quarto-live](https://r-wasm.github.io/quarto-live/){target="_blank"}. You can interact with pre-loaded CosMx<sup>&#174;</sup> SMI results
or analyze your own results all from your browser. 

<br>
<br>

[Differential Expression Explorer for CosMx<sup>&#174;</sup> SMI](de_explorer/index.html) 

::: columns
::: {.column width="65%"}

Interact with your differential expression results derived [`smiDE`](https://nanostring-biostats.github.io/CosMx-Analysis-Scratch-Space/#category=differential%20expression){target="_blank"} with this tool.
